name: SWE-EVO
description: Existing benchmarks for AI coding agents focus on isolated, single-issue tasks such as fixing a bug or adding a small feature. However, real-world software engineering is a long-horizon endeavor: developers interpret high-level requirements, coordinate changes across many files, and evolve codebases over multiple iterations while preserving functionality. We introduce SWE-EVO, a benchmark for this long-horizon software evolution challenge.
